name: Cerasuolo di Vittoria

known.via: English Wikipedia "Cerasuolo di Vittoria DOCG" (redirects to "Cerasuolo di Vittoria")

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: Sicily's only DOCG, a dry red from around Vittoria. Cerasuolo means cherry red.
